entry: Today I built and shipped a verifiable v3 context-resilience proof bundle end-to-end: schema, API contracts, deterministic queries, crash durability evidence, and a full handoff finalize demo with hashes and event IDs. It mattered because we closed the gap between 'implemented' and 'provably wired'-the exact failure mode that causes trust to decay in distributed systems. What drove me was clarity and accountability: making claims that can be verified in minutes, then pushing the exact commit to GitHub so anyone can reproduce and audit it later.
